notes: family: area-majority. Payout is done physically at game end after each player adds their 3 hand cards to their tableau: per company, the player with strictly most cards is paid 1 coin per card by each other holder of that company; tie for most = nobody paid. Paid coins flip to the 3 side; unused starting coins stay worth 1; Anti-Monopoly chip stops taking market cards of a company you hold the lead in. Winner = most money. Model records final coin counts instead of recomputing payouts. Official Oink rulebook PDF not retrievable; tiebreaker (most 3-coins, then went last) comes only from RulesPal summary and is unverified, one other review says tie rule unspecified.
